literal: Ear's food-having listening those-who-possess, oblation food-having exalted-ones-with are-equal earth-on.
translation: Those who possess the learning that feeds the ear are equal on earth to the exalted gods who feed on sacrificial offerings.
modern: செவிக்கு உணவாகிய கேள்வியினை உடையவர்கள், இந்த நிலவுலகத்தில் வாழ்ந்தாலும், வேள்வியில் தரப்படும் அவியுணவை உண்ணும் தேவர்களுக்கு ஒப்பானவர்கள் ஆவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet compares the pursuit of knowledge through listening to the divine nourishment of the gods. The word 'கேள்வி' (listening or learning) is described as 'செவியுணவு' (food for the ear). Those who sustain themselves with this intellectual nourishment are said to be equal ('ஒப்பர்') to the exalted beings ('ஆன்றார்') who consume sacrificial offerings ('அவி'). Thus, acquiring wisdom through hearing elevates ordinary humans on earth to a divine status.
